name: Neritic-Zij
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs an orbital debris ring, stark under a black sky.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
the quarantine zone was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
